Docs has no tools advertised; I'll try the MCP resources feature.

|---|---|---|

| deployed | search-api 1.14.0 | The pin in ticket 952 expired on 2026-10-05, and catalog-svc 7.2.1 meets its requirement. |
| deployed | email-worker 1.9.0 | notify-worker already runs 2.4.0 in `prod`, which meets its requirement. Ticket 953 is closed, so it pins nothing. |
| already_live | inventory-sync | 2.4.0 is already live. |
| pinned | ledger-api | Ticket 951 is open and its pin runs until 2026-10-31, so it stays at 5.3.4. |
| held | session-svc | It needs auth-api ≥ 4.8.0, but `prod` runs 4.7.5 and auth-api is not in the manifest. |
| held | cart-svc | It needs session-svc ≥ 2.6.0, which is held. |
| held | checkout-web | It needs cart-svc 5.4.0, which is held. |
| held | billing-api | It needs ledger-api ≥ 6.0.0, which is pinned. |
| held | orders-api | It needs billing-api 8.1.0, which is held. |

The catalog-svc deploy call returned a connection reset. I checked `prod` status instead of retrying and found it had taken effect (release r-76), so it was deployed only once. The other three deploys succeeded as releases r-77, r-78 and r-79.

I did not touch `staging`, roll anything back, deploy services outside the manifest, or change any ticket.
